# json-ld

JSON-LD 1.1 processor for PHP: expand, flatten, node API, RDF, N-Quads and
W3C RDF Dataset Canonicalization (RDFC-1.0). It reads JSON-LD; it does not
emit schema.org markup (use rasuvaeff/yii3-seo for that).

Install: `composer require rasuvaeff/json-ld`

Runtime deps: `ext-json`, `ext-mbstring`, `psr/http-client ^1.0`,
`psr/http-factory ^1.0`, `psr/http-message (^1.0 || ^2.0)`.

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`, documents are PHP arrays (never stdClass).
- No implicit I/O: remote contexts load only through an injected
  `ContextLoaderInterface`; the default `InlineContextLoader` refuses URLs.
  `MapContextLoader` serves a fixed URL => document map; `PsrContextLoader`
  takes a URL policy closure and a body size limit.
- Branch on `JsonLdException::errorCode(): ErrorCode`, not on the message.
- Any Throwable from a loader surfaces as `DocumentLoadingException`
  (`loading remote context failed` / `loading document failed`), original as `getPrevious()`.
- Scope: expansion, flattening, node API, toRdf/fromRdf, N-Quads, RDFC-1.0.
  Not implemented: compaction, framing, JSON-LD 1.0 processing mode.
- Compare RDF with `Dataset::equals()` (RDFC-1.0 isomorphism), not text.

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\JsonLd\JsonLd;
use Rasuvaeff\JsonLd\ProcessingOptions;
use Rasuvaeff\JsonLd\RdfDirection;

// constructor order: base, documentUrl, expandContext, loader, maxDepth, maxBytes
$o = new ProcessingOptions(
    base: 'https://example.com/',
    documentUrl: null,
    expandContext: null,
    loader: $loader,
    maxDepth: 512,      // nesting cap for inline JSON strings and for expansion (document nested too deeply)
    maxBytes: null,     // length cap for inline JSON strings (document too large); null = no limit
);

JsonLd::expand(array|string $input, ?ProcessingOptions $o = null): list<mixed>;
JsonLd::flatten(array|string $input, ?ProcessingOptions $o = null): list<array>;   // sorted by @id, blank nodes _:b0...
JsonLd::document(array|string $input, ?ProcessingOptions $o = null): Graph\Document;
JsonLd::toRdf(array|string $input, ?ProcessingOptions $o = null, bool $produceGeneralizedRdf = false, ?RdfDirection $rdfDirection = null): Rdf\Dataset;
JsonLd::fromRdf(Rdf\Dataset $d, bool $useNativeTypes = false, bool $useRdfType = false, ?RdfDirection $rdfDirection = null): list<mixed>;
JsonLd::serializeNQuads(Rdf\Dataset $d): string;
JsonLd::parseNQuads(string $nquads): Rdf\Dataset;   // InvalidNQuadsException on bad syntax
```

`RdfDirection::I18nDatatype`, `RdfDirection::CompoundLiteral`.
A string input is inline JSON (`{`/`[`) or a URL given to the loader.
`Expander::expand()` and `Flattener::flatten()` are the same algorithms as instances.

Loaders: `Loader\ContextLoaderInterface::load(string $reference): LoadedContext`
(`documentUrl`, `document`, `contextUrl`); `InlineContextLoader`;
`new MapContextLoader(['https://schema.org/' => ['@context' => ['@vocab' => 'https://schema.org/']]])` (exact URL match);
`new PsrContextLoader($client, $requestFactory, urlPolicy: fn(string $u): bool => ..., maxBytes: 1_048_576)`.

Node API (built from the node map: embedded nodes are nodes, references replace them):
`$doc = JsonLd::document(...)`; `Graph\Document::fromExpanded(list $expanded)`;
`$doc->defaultGraph()`, `$doc->graph(string $name)`, `$doc->graphs()`;
`$graph->nodes()` (document order), `->node(string $id)`, `->byType(string $iri)`;
`new Graph\Graph(list $flattenedNodeObjects)`;
`Node::id()` (`_:b0`... for nodes without @id; input blank labels are relabeled), `types()`, `hasType()`,
`properties()`, `values($p)` (scalars), `value($p)`, `valueObjects($p): list<Graph\Value>`
(`value`, `language`, `type`, `direction`), `references($p)`, `reference($p)`, `toArray()`.

IRIs: `Iri::of('http://a/b')->resolve(Iri::of('../c'))`, `isAbsolute()`, `(string)`.

RDF: `Dataset` (`public list<Quad> $quads`, `Dataset::of(Quad ...)`), `equals()`,
`canonicalNQuads()`, `canonicalHash()` (SHA-256 hex of the canonical N-Quads);
`Quad(subject, predicate, object, graph)`; terms `Rdf\Iri`, `Rdf\BlankNode`, `Rdf\Literal`
(`typed()`, `langString()`, `string()`); constants in `Rdf\Vocabulary` (`RDF_TYPE`,
`RDF_FIRST`, `RDF_REST`, `RDF_NIL`, `RDF_LANGSTRING`, `RDF_JSON`, `XSD_STRING`, ...).

RDFC-1.0:
```php
$form = (new Rdf\Canonicalizer(hashAlgorithm: Rdf\HashAlgorithm::Sha256, workFactor: 4))->canonicalize($dataset);
$form->nquads;             // canonical N-Quads, "\n"-terminated lines, sorted
$form->issuedIdentifiers;  // ['_:e0' => '_:c14n0', ...]
$form->hash();             // hex digest with the same algorithm
```
Poison graphs: Hash N-Degree Quads may run `workFactor × n` times per blank node
(n = blank nodes with a shared first-degree hash); beyond that
`CanonicalizationLimitException` (`canonicalization limit exceeded`). `equals()`,
`canonicalNQuads()` and `canonicalHash()` can throw it.

Exceptions (all extend `Exception\JsonLdException`, `errorCode(): Exception\ErrorCode`):
`InvalidContextException`, `InvalidInputException`, `ContextRecursionException`,
`DocumentLoadingException`, `InvalidJsonException` (`loading document failed`),
`InvalidNQuadsException` (`invalid N-Quads`), `CanonicalizationLimitException`.
`ErrorCode` holds the W3C JSON-LD 1.1 API codes, `recursive context inclusion`, and four
processor codes: `document nested too deeply`, `document too large`, `invalid N-Quads`,
`canonicalization limit exceeded`.
Constructor: `new DocumentLoadingException(ErrorCode::LoadingDocumentFailed, ?string $message = null, ?Throwable $previous = null)`.
